tryit.intro: Type a sentence and it takes the same path your voice would. You see which skill answered and what the device said.
tryit.ask.title: Ask the device
tryit.ask.label: Sentence
tryit.ask.hint: The answer is also spoken out loud on the device.
tryit.result.timeout: No answer within the wait. The skills service may be busy or down.
tryit.result.nomatch: No skill knew what to do with that.
tryit.speak.title: Hear the voice
tryit.speak.label: Text to speak
tryit.speak.hint: The sound comes out of the device, not this browser. Use it to hear a voice before you settle on it.
tryit.live.title: Live activity
tryit.live.hint: What the device hears and says when you talk to it, as it happens. Say the wake word near the device and watch it appear here. Sentences you type above are not shown here.
tryit.live.empty: Nothing yet. This list fills when you talk to the device and it answers.
tryit.live.needsToken: The live feed needs the device access token. Sign in with it to see activity.
